source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A fairly common, expected experience that would not typically warrant any further discussion or follow-up afterward","B":"An occurrence generally considered impossible to happen, requiring fairly little follow-up even if it were reported","C":"Anesthesia awareness, a rare but recognized phenomenon that should be reported and may benefit from psychological support and follow-up","D":"Clear evidence that a surgical or anesthesia error has taken place at some point during the procedure itself"}}
source_row.rationale: Anesthesia awareness, a rare but recognized phenomenon involving some level of consciousness or memory during intended general anesthesia, should be taken seriously, reported per facility protocol, and may benefit from psychological support and follow-up given potential distress.
source_row.source_name: ASA — Anesthesia Awareness Recognition and Response
